# Safari Room

> Safari Room announces the release How to Keep a Fire Burning on their site. The band played Analog at Hutton Hotel in March 2026.

## Facts
- Who: Safari Room is an indie rock and alternative rock band.
- Genre: Indie rock, Alternative rock
- Based in: Nashville, TN
- Next show: None announced right now.
- Booking: alec@safariroomband.com
